topic.title: Juniper Interface Down Troubleshooting
topic.symptom: A physical or logical interface is down, causing loss of connectivity.

stateInterpretation.case: Physical and logical layers are operational.
Physical layer is up but logical/protocol state is down.
Physical/link layer is down or administratively disabled.

troubleshooting.step: Check whether the interface is administratively disabled.
Verify speed, duplex, FEC, optics, and breakout configuration.
Verify VLAN/tagging and encapsulation for logical interfaces.
Confirm the expected IP address and subnet.

topic.evidence: Always record interface state, counters, optics diagnostics, configuration, alarms, and remote-end status before making changes.
